items.title: Watch the *sunrise.*
items.body: Set an alarm, bring a blanket, say nothing at all.

items.title: A *stargazing* night.
items.body: Lie outside, find shapes, make up your own constellations.

items.title: Get lost in a *new neighborhood.*
items.body: Walk somewhere you’ve never been. No plan, no spending.

items.title: A *library* swap.
items.body: Ten minutes to pick a book for each other. No peeking.

items.title: Living room *dance party.*
items.body: One playlist each. Push the sofa back. Go.

items.title: An at-home *photoshoot.*
items.body: Recreate your very first photo together.

items.title: Memory lane *night.*
items.body: Scroll your oldest photos and tell the stories behind them.

items.title: Teach each other *a skill.*
items.body: A song, a recipe, a card trick. Then swap.

items.title: Volunteer *together.*
items.body: An afternoon at a shelter, a food bank or a clean-up.

items.title: Write a *bucket list.*
items.body: Twenty things you want to do together. Start with one.

slides.title: Save this *for the end of the month.*
slides.sub: Then send it to the one who keeps checking their bank app.
